name: Craft-apps
description: ArtCraft is a suite of open source creative applications written in Rust. This image bundles PhotoCraft (image editor), VectorCraft (vector illustration), FilmCraft (video editor), LightCraft (photo library and raw developer), PdfCraft (PDF workbench), EffectCraft (motion graphics and VFX compositor), DesignCraft (page layout and publishing) and FigCraft (interface design and prototyping) in a single desktop.
short_desc: ArtCraft is a suite of open source creative applications written in Rust
author: linuxserver.io
